messages:
sarah-support: heads up — multiple customers reporting 503s + timeouts hitting hosted inference in eu-west ~09:12 UTC. seeing spike in gateway errors and a handful of long tail client timeouts :grimacing:

maya-ops: I already saw the pager. APM shows a sudden increase in ingress fanout retries to our euFargate pool. Circuit-breaker tripped for a few frontends.

ryan-eng: repro steps i used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"rwd-ort-1","input":"hello"}' -v
```
returns HTTP/1.1 503 intermittently after ~6s with connection resets.

jamie-ml: adding note — model rwd-ort-1 had a new quantized build rolled 02:00 UTC in eu-west yesterday. could be an execution regression with kv cache pressure. not ruling out routing/backpressure mismatch.

deploy-bot: ALERT: infra.alerts.gateway.503.rate > 5m threshold at 2026-03-12T09:13:05Z — affected clusters: eu-west-inference-1, eu-west-ingress-3

eli-cs: two enterprise customers opened severity-1 tickets citing user-facing timeouts and webhook retries. they see ~20% of requests fail with 503, multi-region fallbacks kick in.

maya-ops: containment plan proposal:
- temporarily set ingress fanout concurrency cap down to 2 for eu-west-ingress-3
- pause autoscale to avoid noisy neighbor warmups
- route new requests to eu-west-inference-2 (different instance pool)
Can someone approve and run? I can patch routing in 5 mins.

ryan-eng: approve. i will also add a short-lived circuit-breaker override to reduce retry fanout from frontends. pushing canary now to inference-2.

jamie-ml: in parallel let's switch the fallback model for affected routes to rwd-ort-1-small (lower mem/KV pressure) so customers are degraded but live. we should also snapshot a few failing requests for eval.

maya-ops: performed routing patch at 09:21 UTC — ingress-3 reduced concurrency, route weight shifted to inference-2. monitoring: 503 rate dropped from 18% -> 6% within 2 minutes. timeouts improved but still above baseline.

ryan-eng: ran a targeted repro against inference-1 and inference-2. inference-1 still 503s on longer prompts (seqlen > 1024). inference-2 stable for same payload. saved logs to s3://redwood-incidents/1799994322/repro-logs.tar.gz

jamie-ml: dug into model runtime logs — several out-of-memory and repeated kv-cache miss spikes coinciding with requests that had long sequences and many concurrent prefix states. hypothesis: new quantized kernel increases transient memory fragmentation under high fanout.

eli-cs: customer comms drafted. telling customers we mitigated routing hot-path, actively investigating root cause, ETA for full remediation 48h, offering credits. (thumbsup for message?)

maya-ops: action items (owners & ETA):
- ryan-eng: rollback quantized build on eu-west-inference-1 -> ETA 2h (in progress)
- jamie-ml: run mem/kv stress test matrix and reproduce locally -> ETA 6h
- ops: add alert refinement to separate kv-miss spikes from generic 503s -> ETA 4h
- cs: send customer update and credit offers -> ETA 30m
Please add more if I missed anything.

ryan-eng: starting rollback canary now. command I ran: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/rwd-ort-1 --namespace=eu-west-inference-1 --to-revision=1234` — monitoring closely. will escalate if rollback fails.

deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT: rollout undo initiated by ryan-eng at 2026-03-12T09:35:12Z — canary pod 1/3 terminated, new pod scheduling.

maya-ops: noted: after canary the 503 rate on inference-1 pods dropped to baseline on the canary node. spreading rollback cluster-wide pending full verification.

jamie-ml: after rollback confirm we should run an A/B workload that simulates long prefix traffic and mixed batch sizes. i'll prepare scripts and an eval set with failing cases.

eli-cs: customers acknowledged the interim update and appreciate the quick response. two customers asked for daily updates until fixed.

sarah-support: postmortem owner nomination: jamie-ml volunteers to lead root cause analysis and write the report. ryan-eng + maya-ops to contribute mitigation timeline. cs will manage comms. target postmortem draft in 72h.

ryan-eng: quick checklist for postmortem:
- reproduce failure locally (with stress matrix)
- correlate quantized kernel metrics + pod memory maps
- confirm rollback reproves production load
- add regression test to CI for kv-cache fragmentation scenario
- propose permanent config change for fanout backpressure

maya-ops: thanks everyone. I'll update incident tracker and mark this thread as handoff -> postmortem. tagging on-call for follow-through. :white_check_mark:

sarah-support: closing the war-room chat — continue work in postmortem doc and action-tracking. will post customer follow-up notes after next update. :megaphone:
